# Vendored dependencies

`wodix/` is based on [RigelNana/wodix](https://github.com/RigelNana/wodix), revision `2f5c0e30655c7c8690799b610fc820fccf4a2375`, with local integration changes included in this repository.

It is checked in as source, not a Git submodule. Its [MIT license](wodix/LICENSE) and [provenance notice](wodix/crates/wodix/NOTICE) are retained. The small authored MDX/MDD test fixtures belong to the library; personal dictionaries and generated caches are excluded.
